id./param/scenario/cs/b_100_cs_020.pack|cs_: "Begone... Begone...
"Begoooone!!
"There you are, monster! I, Hendrik, will slay you!
"I-I am the god of fire's avatar! If you don't want to be torn apart, turn back at once!
"We'll punish the naughty monsters who bully the villagers! Prepare yourselves!
"W-What? What's going on...?
"...Big brother. These people aren't running away at all. What do we do?
"Idiot, don't talk! You have to act like a monster so they run in fear!!
"Waah...!
"Ow... Idiot! It's your fault, Atsuko! They found us!
"No it isn't! It's because Atsuo didn't hold me up properly!
"Oh my! The scary monsters were such cute kids!
"Are you villagers? Why were you pretending to be monsters!?
"Because... because! We can't let Miko do the rite!
"Um, um! If we don't stop the rite, something awful will happen!
"...There seems to be a reason. {var:1}, shall we hear these children out?
"Huh, you'll listen to us, brothers!?
"Hey, big brother. Maybe {var:1} and the others will help us...
"Yeah, they look strong. Having them along would be reassuring!
"Our secret base is up ahead. We'll tell you the details there. We'll go ahead, so you've got to come!
"Come, come!"
